description: This PHP file defines a controller class for the OpenCart admin dashboard, specifically managing the order widget. It includes methods for displaying the order dashboard, saving configuration, and generating order statistics for the dashboard interface.

classes.name: Order
classes.description: Controller class for managing the order dashboard widget in the OpenCart admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the order dashboard page with configuration options and links.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving the dashboard configuration settings and returns success or error messages in JSON format.

methods.name: dashboard
methods.description: Generates and returns the order statistics widget HTML, including total orders and percentage change over the previous day.
